Download address of the USGS quadrangle: https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Maps/HistoricalTopo/PDF/NJ/24000/NJ_Lakehurst_254519_1947_24000_geo.pdf (The National Map historical topographic maps, quadrangle ID 254519).
National Archives catalogue entry for NARA 518856: https://catalog.archives.gov/id/518856 . Commons gives the date as 1937-01-25, a day when the Hindenburg was not in the US; the film gives no date and labels it only “此前一次停靠” ("an earlier mooring").
